sources.label: Morphe patches for popular Dutch applications, unlocking ad-free and tracking fr
sources.author: Dutch applications
patch_list: Disables inspected Tealium, Snowplow, NPAW, advertising-ID, New Relic and automatic Google/Facebook measurement paths, including queued CCT uploads. Functional services remain; full traffic acceptance is pending.
Suppresses client video, banner and pause-ad requests. Uses the supplied live fallback when Yospace resource creation is omitted. Ad-supported playback and server-side coverage need feedback.
